acceptance.limitation: Shared-backbone paired downstream equivalence, not independent-run CUDA bitwise determinism or convergence.

limits: All P2 windows were 0 committed / 30 live at capture. Source-step backups do not prove those later 30 rows durable.
Different natural training windows are observations, not a same-input causal benchmark.
Baseline detailed diagnostics are off; first 30 post-migration updates have detailed diagnostics on.
Median update excludes log/save/validation; window wall includes first-update cold-start and intervening events.
Sparse resource samples do not establish time-weighted GPU utilization or kernel occupancy; RSS sums may double-count shared pages.
ETA excludes unmeasured full validation, future failures and downtime; no convergence or physical success claim.
No E1/E2/E4 launch or L20 GPU0 cleanup is implied. Public records exclude internal paths, UUIDs, PIDs and raw telemetry.
